notes: Windows: fixed the app closing as soon as it opened. Every Windows copy of 0.5.1 had this problem.
Windows: the download is now one installer. Double-click it and the app installs, adds an icon to your desktop and Start menu, and opens. No unzipping, and you can uninstall it in Settings > Apps.
If the app can't start, it now says why instead of closing without a word, and keeps the details in its log.
After your first question, a new chat opens to a shorter welcome: the emergency note and example questions.
Check for updates no longer says to check your internet connection when there simply isn't an update.
While the library unpacks, setup shows how far along it is and the time left, instead of a bar that looked stuck.
Asking a question before setup finishes says plainly that the library is still installing and the answer has no sources yet.
The first answer's wait says "Cpt. Vinny is getting ready" instead of talking about memory and fans.
Menu › Remove downloads deletes the library and AI models to free their space before you uninstall. Your own files, notes and settings stay.
Windows: uninstalling offers to delete the library and AI models too, and, only if you tick it, your own files and notes.
